warnings.why: Croatia's preprimary education system typically spans 1 to 3 years before primary school, making a reported duration of 7 years implausible for standard preprimary education.
Estonia generally provides kindergarten for children up to 7 years old, but the formal structured preprimary education duration is much shorter, not 7 distinct grades.
Lithuania has a 1-year mandatory preprimary program plus optional early childhood education, but a reported 7-year duration miscounts standard grade levels.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
